title: Two Strategic Traditions
subtitle: How different games produce different instincts about technology control

columns.title: Chess Thinking
items: Control the center, dominate key squares
Clear win condition: the king falls
US approach: 'small yard, high fence' — deny the critical node

columns.title: Go (围棋) Thinking
items: Relative advantage — win by more territory
Every stone stays on the board — nothing is wasted
No single decisive blow; accumulation wins
China approach: 举国体制 — mobilize everything, route around
